codeVersion: 0.5.0-alpha.1 working tree @ git 68f9644 (uncommitted alpha.2 batch-1 implementation)
changes: integration/project-policy.js: MODE_RANK exported; readProjectPolicy reports usable:false for an existing-but-unreadable file; renderProjectPolicy explains the refusal

src/dispatch.js: resolveDispatchCwd resolves an omitted/relative cwd against the calling agent's working directory (host workingDirectory service, session header cwd, process cwd fallback) before any policy read or spawn; per-call mode and timeout are clamped/refused to the project ceiling; the harness-level timeout is also bounded on the direct surface; OMC/PROJECT-POLICY-UNREADABLE refuses side-effect dispatch when the project file exists but cannot be understood

integration/cli-result.js + src/session-adapters.js: parseSessionOutput reports envelope (structured output actually recognized); with expectJson (requested machine-readable output) a missing envelope or an envelope without a terminal message is OMC/CLI-SEMANTIC-FAILURE — never a stdout fallback; a deadline kill is classified timeout, not cancelled
src/dispatch.js directRun: expectJson is now false for direct runs, which never request JSON output

integration/preset-snapshot.js: startup baseline is written once per parent session (ensureStartup) and manual snapshots are labeled and stored beside it; COMPARED_FIELDS now covers execution and maxTokens
vendor preset subagent-roles.js + integration/status.js: every role's observed request route (with reroute marker) is recorded beside the configured route and surfaced as actualRoute in status
regressions: test/integration/wp01-correctness.test.mjs (10 tests: A01 gate/timeout/fallback, A02 cwd resolution + unreadable policy, A03 parser→classifier combinations, A04 observed route); test/integration/preset-snapshot.test.mjs extended (startup immutability, manual labeling, execution/maxTokens diff)

observed.fullSuite: 27/27 files pass (node test chain, Desktop node v24.21.0)

boundaries: the project mode ceiling keeps the shipped rank semantics (read-only < in-place < worktree); a per-kind allow set is a future config-schema change, not a per-call decision
the provider surface's own spawn timeout stays at its harness config; the dispatch-level deadline signal still bounds the observable run
startup baseline means 'frozen at this session's first OMC observation', not literally process start; the status note says so
